scenes.description: Title screen over downtown Neon Bay: Rex on foot at the plaza, traffic passing on the roads, the city blocks, crosswalks and minimap behind the menu.
Driving in downtown traffic: Rex at the wheel, traffic cars around him, pedestrians on the sidewalks, the first job objective and the minimap on the HUD.
Three-star police chase: NBPD cruisers on Rex's tail with lights flashing, a foot officer closing in, the wanted stars, mission timer and minimap live.
The King boss fight on the lighthouse beach: King and his crew leashed to the sand, the boss health bar, the lighthouse beam sweeping the bay, Rex fighting on foot.
